'''''Gormegan-1''''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] constructed by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Voss]].<ref name="codex" /> The Gormak were a tech-savvy species, but did not develop space-flight capability previous to contact with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] around [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="HoloVoss">{{Holonet|planets|voss|Voss}}</ref> Following this contact, the Gormak turned their efforts toward constructing [[Starship/Legends|space-craft]].<ref name="Wallpaper">{{TORweb|url=media/wallpapers/voss|text=Wallpaper &ndash; Voss|nolive=1}}</ref> They converted stolen Republic and Imperial technology for their own uses and constructed machinery from salvaged parts. The Gormak built the starship in [[Gorma-Koss]] under the guidance of [[Jokull]] who united dozens of tribes for that project. The Gormak believed that this ship would be the key to their survival.<ref name="codex" />

Through efforts of an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] outsider, the ship was destroyed in [[3641 BBY]], fulfilling a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] prophesy that an outsider would stop [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] from "reaching the stars".<ref name="worldQuest">{{TORcite|type=general|Space Race|[[Voss]]}}</ref>
